comment: Machine-readable Tier-1 core inventory. Single source of truth: SPEC.md prose and tools/spec_check.py both derive from this file. Indices and check bits are normative (the register rule and digit assignments depend on them).

content.notes: licensed realizations [tʃ]~[ts] (affricate standard); [ʃ] is attested L1 drift, not licensed — keeps t+i vs c+i distinct under palatalization

particle.notes: reserved for particles; canonical realizations [h]~[x]~[ʔ] — never bare resyllabification (see SPEC §2.1, §5.2)

registers.realization: long: always marked in the written layer (romanized by doubling, derivable); optionally realized as vowel length >= 1.5x in careful/safety speech registers; absent in casual speech

register_rule.lexical_side: syllables satisfying the rule; the only side words may use
register_rule.complement_side: anti-check syllables; reserved for mode payloads
register_rule.what_it_detects: WRITTEN LAYER / CAREFUL REGISTERS ONLY: check-value noise trivially, plus every single-channel substitution between two values with different check bits (covered_confusion_pairs); casual speech carries no check — its protection is the humility assignment, templates, context, repair
register_rule.what_it_does_not_detect: substitutions between same-check-bit values; forbidden residual pairs are banned by the humility rule, weighted residual pairs are licensable at a scored cost
register_rule.note: an earlier draft used index parity and claimed uniform Hamming distance 2; that claim was wrong (same-parity substitutions were invisible) and the uniform-distance-2 alternative caps the space at 20 codewords (mod-10 check over the largest channel), which is why coverage is confusion-weighted instead
register_rule.status: WRITTEN-LAYER CHANNEL (tentative demotion, Edward 2026-08-09, conlang-bf2): the check bit is computed and always present in the written layer (glyph zone, romanization doubling); spoken realization as vowel length is OPTIONAL and belongs to careful/safety registers; casual speech does not carry it. Re-promotion to a mandatory spoken channel is a documented minor-version path.

covered_confusion_pairs.comment: high-likelihood same-channel confusions that MUST have different check bits; spec_check.py asserts each

residual_confusion_pairs.comment: same-check-bit pairs the written-layer check cannot catch; the humility rule bans the forbidden subset as unrelated minimal pairs, the weighted subset is licensable at a scored cost

particle.namespace_width: PROVISIONAL until conlang-jbw enumerates the structural inventory — not part of the freeze candidate

content.stress: first syllable, realized as pitch/intensity/duration (duration available in casual speech since the register is written-layer)
content.pos_coda: final syllable coda encodes part of speech

digit_units_rimes.comment: units digit -> rime; 0-4 = bare vowel (coda index 0), 5-9 = vowel + coda n (coda index 1)

confusion_policy.comment: HUMILITY ASSIGNMENT (adopted 2026-08-09, conlang-bf2): no two UNRELATED lexical words may differ by a single high-confusion substitution — covered_confusion_pairs AND forbidden both conflict; weighted pairs are allowed as minimal pairs at a scored cost, avoided among high-frequency assignments. forbidden+weighted must still exactly partition residual_confusion_pairs (spec_check asserts). Same-root POS alternations exempt.

lexical_cell_rules.comment: structured lexicon-rule data (SPEC 4.3); tools load these — nothing phonological is hardcoded in code
lexical_cell_rules.echo_vowels_note: epenthetic vowel qualities attested in the target L1s: Japanese [ɯ]->u and [o] after coronal stops, Korean [i] after palatals

capacity_expected.comment: exact outputs of tools/lexgen.py capacity_report; spec_check asserts these so SPEC/paper prose cannot drift from the computed truth

spacing_rules: register-only contrast: impossible by construction (register is computed)

humility rule (v0.2, conlang-bf2): no two UNRELATED lexical words may differ by a single high-confusion substitution — covered_confusion_pairs UNION confusion_policy.forbidden; weighted pairs are licensable at a scored cost; same-root POS alternations exempt
echo-vowel rule (all positions): a coda s/l and the same consonant plus an echo vowel may not both occur where they could be confused — /...Cs/ vs /...Csu/ and medial equivalents
fake-geminate rule: a coda consonant followed by an identical onset may not contrast with the single-consonant parse (/nas.sa/ vs /na.sa/)

glide-cell rule: syllables ji and wu are not lexical (the glide onset perceptually fuses with the homorganic vowel, producing an apparently onset-less syllable that would misparse as a particle); jV/wV cells with near-homorganic vowels (je, wo) carry extra weighting
coronal-i rule: no t/c or s/c lexical minimal pairs before vowel i (ti->[tʃi], si->[ɕi] palatalization for several major L1s lands inside c's space)

anti-resyllabification (tosmabru-class): for any lexical word ending in a consonant coda followed by any particle, the resyllabified surface string may not parse as a legal word sequence — generator-enforced over the actual lexicon and particle inventory

script_features.comment: v0.2 confusion-aware anti-iconic assignment (conlang-wqj): compositional base x modifier grammar retained; the phoneme->cell assignment is solved by tools/assign_glyphs.py as an error-correcting code — every phonetic confusion pair (covered+forbidden+weighted) differs in BOTH base and modifier. Emergent mnemonic: base = digit_tens mod 4. h keeps the tick base alone (lightest glyph).

modifiers.crossed: full attached stroke crossing the base through its center
modifiers.doubled: wide-offset parallel copy (>=13 units perpendicular separation)
modifiers.capped: full attached horizontal stroke at the top of the base

visual_grammar.vowel: carrier bar; tick height = vowel height (high/mid/low), tick direction = backness (front=left, back=right, central=both)
visual_grammar.coda: strip-native full-width marks (POS gets the loudest ink): empty=zero coda (noun), single bar=n (verb), double bar=s (modifier), hooked bar=l (reserved)
visual_grammar.check_slot: top-right filled dot = written check 1 (lexical); payload spans are marked by a continuous run-rule beside the glyph stack, not per-block marks
visual_grammar.headroom: 5 bases x 4 modifiers - 2 banned cells = 18 onset cells (11 used, implemented cells whitelisted in the renderer); 3x3 vowel grid + rounding modifier; further modifiers (e.g. inner dot) are wide-model reserves (SPEC 9)

script_confusion_pairs.comment: The eye's residual weak pairs = the same-base pairs, BY CONSTRUCTION of the v0.2 anti-iconic code (same-base pairs are phonetically distant, so neither the humility rule nor the ear protects a silent READER from them; c/w and k/l additionally share check bits). Priced by lexgen strict_with_script so the lexicon avoids minting unrelated minimal pairs on them. 14x14 raster distances (test_script.py floor): c/w 0.231, c/m 0.250, m/w 0.388, p/j 0.368, p/n ~0.5, j/n ~0.5, t/s ~0.6, k/l 0.406. spec_check enforces that every same-base pair is listed here.
